title: Echoes of My Son stays on the 15th
summary: The sanctuary’s own pages still put Âm vang Mỹ Sơn on the 15th of each month, at groups B, C, and D, at 09:00 and 14:45. A newer 2026 confirmation was not on those pages. Whether the show is inside the ticket is check on arrival.
when: The 15th of each month, at 09:00 and 14:45.
photoAlt: Brick Cham towers at My Son
body: If the monthly show is the reason to go, the clock is still the one printed by the sanctuary. The 2019 hours notice and the live ticket site both place Echoes of My Son at groups B, C, and D on the 15th, at 09:00 and 14:45. The day of the month does not move on those two pages.

A newspaper page that would have confirmed the 2026 clock did not load when this was checked, so nothing newer was added. The pages do not say whether this show is included in the entrance ticket, and they do not print a weather rule for it. Both of those stay check on arrival. The separate group G performance, also listed at 09:00 and 14:45, can be stopped for bad weather.
